posts.text: 👶💙 It’s a Baby Dawg!Former Georgia wide receiver Ladd McConkey and his wife, Sydney, revealed Wednesday that they are expecting a baby boy.The couple first announced their pregnancy on August 2, and shared the gender reveal together on Instagram Wednesday.McConkey will always have a special place in Athens. The North Georgia native finished his #UGA career with 119 catches for 1,687 yards and 14 receiving touchdowns, helping #Georgia win back-to-back National Championships in 2021 and 2022.The Los Angeles #Chargers selected him with the No. 34 overall pick in the 2024 #NFL Draft. As a rookie, McConkey set Chargers rookie records with 82 catches and 1,149 receiving yards before putting up an NFL rookie postseason-record 197 receiving yards in his playoff debut.

posts.author: Blitz_Burgh@sportsbots.xyz
posts.text: Adam Thielen on the Steelers offense in Week 1: “I didn’t feel a lot of great rhythm from that offense. I didn’t see that they were in sync as far as run, pass, play action. When I looked at that game back, it didn’t feel like anything looked like it was working together. In this league, you have to have things working together. I feel like they didn’t do that. There was a lot of short passes, quick game. Then, when you throw those explosive plays and have an opportunity to catch them, you’ve gotta hit them, especially when you play that style of football. I’d like to see a little bit more in sync.” #Steelers #NFL

posts.author: Blitz_Burgh@sportsbots.xyz
posts.text: Aaron Rodgers on the offense in Week 1: “I mean, the whole thing can be deceiving. We had the PI on third down that could have been the touchdown. We had a PI on DK that wasn't called. We had an opportunity to [Roman Wilson] down the field that was not called. He didn't come up with it. Had DK in the end zone, for sure PI, and he still almost made a ridiculous catch, and the one that DK obviously usually catches. One or two of those goes, and it's a whole different conversation. That's the way the league goes. You can't get caught up in too many specific numbers without looking at what happened in the game.” #Steelers #NFL
